VAR-age.why: Household roster includes age in years for each member

VAR-agecat.why: Age categories can be derived from age-in-years member roster

VAR-childmth.why: Child module asks present age of child in months

VAR-childyr.why: Child age in years can be taken/derived from member age in years for under-5s
If needed, child months can be converted to years for under-5s

VAR-communicationdisability.why: Disability section includes difficulty in communicating

VAR-concentrationdisorder.why: Disability section includes difficulty remembering (closest to concentration/cognitive difficulty)

VAR-educat4.why: Education section records highest class passed (can be collapsed to 4-level attainment)

VAR-educat5.why: Education section records highest class passed (can be mapped to 5-level attainment)

VAR-educat7.why: Education section records highest class passed (detailed attainment source)

VAR-educy.why: Years of education can be approximated from highest class passed (or mapped from same education source)

VAR-everattend.why: Education section asks where attended/attending (presence implies ever attended); verify coding for never-attended

VAR-literacy.why: Education section asks can read a letter
Education section asks can write a letter (combine read+write for literacy)

VAR-male.why: Household roster includes sex for each member

VAR-mineducatage.why: Education section present; min education application age likely determined from questionnaire universe/onset rather than a data column

VAR-primarycomp.why: Primary completion can be derived from highest class passed / attainment source

VAR-relationcs.why: Household roster has relationship to head (country-specific categories)

VAR-relationharm.why: Relationship-to-head source for harmonized relationship categories

VAR-school.why: Education section asks whether currently attending an education institution

VAR-selfcaredisability.why: Disability section includes difficulty with self care
